note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is a key-bag with three shapes across the 125 shards: the datasets-server infers `{factory, generator, round}` from the six thin-meta records in `batch-r01` / `batch-r05` / `batch-r06`, then cannot cast the 244 records that add `kind` / `seed` / `designed` / `domain` / `stack` (six of which add `lane` on top), which is why `config-size` fails and `viewer` / `search` / `filter` / `statistics` all report false; declaring the union repairs the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: id
features.note: unique across all 250 records; every id carries the `sir-` prefix

features.name: plan
features.note: present on all 250 records and always a string (1-120 chars), never a list; it is not optional in this dataset

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object and every value is a string, but the key set varies: 8 distinct key sets over 7 tools, and `pytest` alone uses both `{args}` (714) and `{target}` (18)

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 4038 of 4123 steps; all 85 absences fall inside the six thin-meta records

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag with five key sets: `success` (bool), `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on all 250, plus `plan_changes` on 244, `retries` on 155, `handoff` and `xfailed` on the same 90, `duration_min` and `wasted_calls` on the same 66; every value is a bool or an int, but the key set varies per record

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag with three key sets: `factory`, `round` (int), `generator` on all 250, plus `kind`, `seed` (string), `designed` (bool), `domain`, `stack` on 244, plus `lane` on 6

disclosures.summary: Six records carry a thin `meta` of only `{factory, generator, round}` with no `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain` or `stack`. They are the records the inferred schema dies on, and they also hold all 85 steps that publish no `reflection` — every step of the other 244 records carries one. They are kept exactly as generated.

Six records in `batch-r02`-`batch-r04` add `meta.lane` (always the string `b`). They are the only records carrying `lane` and the only records whose `reward` omits `plan_changes`; they replay three designed seeds across rounds 2-4.

One record in `batch-r26` is a stub: `goal`, `plan` and `outcome` are the literal string `x`, `meta.domain` is `PLACEHOLDER` and `meta.stack` is `x`, while its 17 steps carry generic scaffold text. Its shape is schema-valid, so it does not break the index; it is kept exactly as generated and is not a usable episode.

disclosures: Same-factory leftover-segment naming: 109 of 250 ids, 118 of 250 goals and 108 of 250 `meta.domain` values contain `leftover` (119 records in the id-or-goal union). That is the advertised leftover-segment / stale-index mechanic of `search-index-rebuild-factory` itself, not a foreign leftover-mill dump.

Every one of the 250 records is a `search-index-rebuild-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, with `meta.round` matching its own shard number on all 250 rows and every id prefixed `sir-`. There is no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis` (4123 of 4123). There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields anywhere in the payload.
